schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS routine_exercises (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS routine_plans (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0), name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, document TEXT NOT NULL)
exercises: SELECT id,name FROM routine_exercises ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE,id
routines: SELECT document FROM routine_plans ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE,id
exerciseByName: SELECT id,name FROM routine_exercises WHERE name=:name COLLATE NOCASE
exerciseExists: SELECT id FROM routine_exercises WHERE id=:id
insertExercise: INSERT INTO routine_exercises (id,name) VALUES (:id,:name) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING
updateRoutine: UPDATE routine_plans SET revision=revision+1,name=:name,document=:document WHERE id=:id AND revision=CAST(:revision AS INTEGER)
